exposure: ultrasound guided transversus abdominis plane block with bupivacaine
received ultrasound guided TAP block and tramadol suppository
cohort: 158 women aged 18-40 years old with ASA physical status I-II scheduled for elective caesarean section.
finding: Ultrasound guided TAP block combined with tramadol suppository provided significantly better post-operative pain relief and higher patient satisfaction compared to tramadol suppository alone.
